args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money previously used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming
banker's rounding per FIN-212. This caused the nightly build failure in
tests/test_money.py (2.665 was rounded up to 2.67 instead of down to 2.66).

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` advertised banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) in its docstring but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`, where `2.665` rounded up to `2.67` instead of down to `2.66`.

## Changes
- Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent, as required by FIN-212.

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed (includes `tests/test_money.py`).
